fusions.name: Seam Finder
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A precise sting that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Keyhole Dart
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 30 damage, hits harder the further it travels, up to 1.6 times its damage at maximum range, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Bullseye Focus
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinpoint Sting
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%.
